ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels covering approximately 85% of the visible fluke surface, with low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated along the trailing edge, tips, and focal circular markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Ventral surface is a continuous white field bounded by a dark trailing edge. Distinct black circular rosettes are distributed across the mid-sections of both lobes. Symmetrical tan-colored mottled patches are visible on the lower medial regions near the water interface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression at the center-point of the fluke with a sharp angular vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations characterized by sharp peaks and varying valley depths along the entire linear boundary; the serrations become more jagged and pronounced towards the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the superior margin of both lobes, tapering into slightly downturned and pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of several discrete circular dark spots and rings (rosettes) distributed across the white field; specifically, a cluster of three prominent marks on the right lobe and one larger mark on the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct dark, curved 'C-shaped' marking is visible on the center-left lobe; several faint, vertical linear pixel disruptions are visible on the lower right lobe near the water line.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple circular barnacle attachment scars; irregular dark clusters on the extreme lateral tips suggest biological encrustation or healed trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Bilateral yellowish-tan pigmentation patches present on the lower interior regions of both lobes, distinct from the primary white and black pigmentation.
